source_standard: Every endpoint definition and every effect estimate below is VERBATIM from the trial's own abstract as PubMed prints it. According to PubMed. Each carries its PMID and DOI.

COLCOT.population_verbatim: patients recruited within 30 days after a myocardial infarction
COLCOT.primary_verbatim: a composite of death from cardiovascular causes, resuscitated cardiac arrest, myocardial infarction, stroke, or urgent hospitalization for angina leading to coronary revascularization
COLCOT.effect_verbatim: The primary end point occurred in 5.5% of the patients in the colchicine group, as compared with 7.1% of those in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.77; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.61 to 0.96; P = 0.02)

LoDoCo2.primary_verbatim: a composite of cardiovascular death, spontaneous (nonprocedural) myocardial infarction, ischemic stroke, or ischemia-driven coronary revascularization
LoDoCo2.effect_verbatim: A primary end-point event occurred in 187 patients (6.8%) in the colchicine group and in 264 patients (9.6%) in the placebo group (incidence, 2.5 vs. 3.6 events per 100 person-years; hazard ratio, 0.69; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.57 to 0.83; P<0.001)
LoDoCo2.follow_up_verbatim: The median duration of follow-up was 28.6 months
LoDoCo2.key_secondary_verbatim: a composite of cardiovascular death, spontaneous myocardial infarction, or ischemic stroke

CLEAR SYNERGY.primary_verbatim: a composite of death from cardiovascular causes, recurrent myocardial infarction, stroke, or unplanned ischemia-driven coronary revascularization, evaluated in a time-to-event analysis
CLEAR SYNERGY.effect_verbatim: A primary-outcome event occurred in 322 of 3528 patients (9.1%) in the colchicine group and 327 of 3534 patients (9.3%) in the placebo group over a median follow-up period of 3 years (hazard ratio, 0.99; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.85 to 1.16; P = 0.93)
CLEAR SYNERGY.follow_up_verbatim: a median follow-up period of 3 years
CLEAR SYNERGY.N_DISAGREES_WITH_ITS_OWN_REGISTRATION: The publication randomised 7,062 (3,528 + 3,534). The ClinicalTrials.gov record declares an enrolment of 7,264. THE DIFFERENCE IS 202 AND THIS FILE DOES NOT RECONCILE IT: the registration's enrolment field counts the 2x2 factorial's full randomised population and the colchicine report counts the colchicine comparison, which is a PLAUSIBLE explanation and is not evidence. The published figure is used because it is the denominator of the effect estimate beside it.

by_component.canonical: revascularisation, REQUIRING URGENT HOSPITALISATION FOR ANGINA

THE_FINDING:
ALL THREE ARE CALLED A MAJOR ADVERSE CARDIOVASCULAR EVENT COMPOSITE AND NO TWO OF THEM DEFINE IT THE SAME WAY. Only ONE component -- cardiovascular death -- appears in all three with the same definition. Every other component differs by a qualifier that changes which events count, and one whole component is present in one trial and absent from the other two:
  RESUSCITATED CARDIAC ARREST is in COLCOT and in neither of the others.
  MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION is ANY in COLCOT, SPONTANEOUS (NONPROCEDURAL) ONLY in LoDoCo2, and RECURRENT in CLEAR SYNERGY. LoDoCo2's qualifier is not cosmetic: it EXCLUDES procedural infarction, and this is a literature in which a large fraction of infarctions are periprocedural.
  STROKE is ANY TYPE in COLCOT and CLEAR SYNERGY and ISCHAEMIC ONLY in LoDoCo2. THAT ONE MATTERS MORE THAN IT LOOKS: colchicine's effect in INTRACEREBRAL HAEMORRHAGE is an open question with its own reading in this split, so a trial that counts only ischaemic strokes and a trial that counts all strokes are measuring the drug against different risks.
  REVASCULARISATION requires URGENT HOSPITALISATION FOR ANGINA in COLCOT, is ISCHAEMIA-DRIVEN in LoDoCo2, and is UNPLANNED AND ISCHAEMIA-DRIVEN in CLEAR SYNERGY.

name_matched_k3.estimator: Paule-Mandel tau-squared, Knapp-Hartung t interval on 2 df with the variance-inflation floor at 1
name_matched_k3.what_it_is: WHAT A NAME-MATCHING REVIEWER PUBLISHES. Computed and reported so its cost is measured rather than asserted, exactly as the apixaban topics did. IT IS NOT THIS PAGE'S ANSWER.
name_matched_k3.why_it_is_not_reported_as_the_result: The three primaries differ by a whole component and by three qualifiers. Averaging them produces a number for a quantity no trial measured.

mi_population_k2.estimator: Paule-Mandel tau-squared, Knapp-Hartung t interval on 1 df with the variance-inflation floor at 1
mi_population_k2.what_it_is: COLCOT and CLEAR SYNERGY -- the two whose population is AFTER MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION, so the population axis is coherent.
mi_population_k2.why_it_is_still_not_reported: THE POPULATION MATCHING DOES NOT FIX THE ESTIMAND. COLCOT counts resuscitated cardiac arrest and CLEAR SYNERGY does not; COLCOT's revascularisation limb requires an urgent hospitalisation for angina and CLEAR SYNERGY's requires only that the revascularisation be unplanned and ischaemia-driven. A shared population is NECESSARY and it is NOT SUFFICIENT -- the same shape as P38, one axis down.

THE_WITHHOLDING_QUESTION_ASKED_AND_ITS_A: Before concluding that nothing pools, the question is put at every rank the sources reach. LoDoCo2 publishes a KEY SECONDARY -- 'a composite of cardiovascular death, spontaneous myocardial infarction, or ischemic stroke', HR 0.72 (0.57 to 0.92) -- which drops revascularisation and is the closest thing to a common estimand in these three papers. NEITHER COLCOT NOR CLEAR SYNERGY REPORTS THAT COMPOSITE IN ITS ABSTRACT. COLCOT does publish every component of its own primary separately, and CLEAR SYNERGY says only that 'the incidence of individual components of the primary outcome appeared to be similar in the two groups' WITHOUT NUMBERS. SO THE ANSWER IS NOT 'NOTHING POOLS'. It is that a component-level or key-secondary-level pool WOULD REQUIRE THE FULL TEXTS, which this pass did not read. That is OWED WORK, recorded as owed, and it is NOT a negative finding -- an absence of a reading is not a reading of absence.
what_this_file_does_NOT_hold: Component-level event counts for any trial. COLCOT's component hazard ratios are in its abstract and are NOT transcribed here, because a component pool needs the same component from every trial and two of the three do not print one.
